name: Julian Huxley

summary.text: Julian Huxley (1887-1975) was a British biologist who served as Secretary of the Zoological Society of London from 1935 to 1942, as the first Director-General of UNESCO from 1946 to 1948, and as president of the British Eugenics Society from 1959 to 1962. His 1957 essay 'Transhumanism', in the collection New Bottles for New Wine, is generally credited with coining the term.

sources.title: Julian Huxley and Transhumanism (text of the 1957 essay)

facts.claim: Huxley's essay 'Transhumanism' appears in New Bottles for New Wine, published in London by Chatto & Windus in 1957, at pages 13-17, and is where he uses the term.
